extraction.notes: AIR reports no AFFO; Pro forma FFO is the adjusted FFO metric (core_total). Starting line is net loss attributable to AIR common stockholders. Gain on dispositions of real estate is shown as an em dash (zero) for Q1 2023; recorded as 0. 'Business transformation and transition related costs' ($213) mapped to severance_restructuring as the closest fit (ERP/finance transformation); it could also be viewed as transaction/other. Diluted shares 148,884 (thousands) reproduces $0.49 NAREIT FFO and $0.55 Pro forma FFO per share (72,633/148,884 and 81,308/148,884). Recurring capex left null: no AFFO section exists, so the AFFO-capex fallback was not applied. For reference, page 27 (Supplemental Schedule 9) discloses proportionate Capital Replacements of $6,212 thousand for the quarter, which is not part of the reconciliation. Page seq 18 printed '15' used for all lines; the page 16 FFO information (Schedule 2a) reconciles to the same $72,633 and $81,308.
